description: Pins the protocol::encode_prefs_blob_raw + protocol::decode_prefs_blob byte mapping for cross-implementation conformance. vault.prefs is the v0.1 vault-level singleton encrypted-preferences blob (MYP1 magic) carrying user-controllable preferences. The v0.1 inner schema (MYND-160 + MYND-183 + MYND-110) carries: screen_capture_protection (bool), deliberate_folders (sorted-set string array), auto_lock_seconds (optional integer), editor_layout (optional nested object), the unified manual-sidebar sequences favorites + item_order (item_order is HETEROGENEOUS — note UUIDs + canonical trailing-slash folder paths interleaved, replacing the pre-MYND-183 note_order/folder_order pair), theme (optional 'light'/'dark' string; absence ≡ system / follow-the-OS), and the decoration maps folder_icons (MYND-185 — nested string→string object: canonical folder path → icon name) + item_colors (MYND-184 — nested string→string object: a heterogeneous note-UUID-or-folder-path key → color-slot name). Canonical key order: auto_lock_seconds < deliberate_folders < editor_layout < favorites < folder_icons < item_colors < item_order < screen_capture_protection < theme; within each decoration object the members are emitted in lexicographic KEY order. Optional fields are omitted-when-default, so a screen_capture-only vault stays byte-identical to a pre-MYND-183 blob. The outer envelope is 34-byte fixed-offset (magic + protocol_version + reserved + 24-byte prefs_nonce + 4-byte big-endian ciphertext_len) followed by AEAD-wrapped canonical-JSON plaintext + 32-byte CTX commitment tag (Chan & Rogaway 2022). prefs_key derives from root_key via the canonical DeriveSubkey helper with HKDF context 'myne.v0.1 prefs-key' (no items_key coupling, see grill Q1). AAD binds account_number_hash + the role string 'prefs-blob' (39 bytes total). Read failure surface is non-distinguishing per spec §6.4 + §9.5.5: wrong key, wrong AAD, tampered ciphertext, tampered CTX tag all collapse to a single AeadFailure. Cases generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_prefs_vectors_for_paste -- --ignored` (in protocol/src/prefs.rs).

cases.description: Canonical encode case with screen_capture_protection=true (PrefsView::default(), the safer-state semantic per spec §9.5.5). Inputs use distinct byte patterns (root_key=0x42×32, account_hash=0x33×16, nonce=0x77×24) so any swap or off-by-one drift surfaces as a clear hex mismatch. Expected blob is exactly 100 bytes (34-header + 34-plaintext + 32-CTX-tag).

User-toggled-off case: screen_capture_protection=false. Same root_key + account_hash as encrypt-default but distinct prefs_nonce (0x88×24) so the encoded blob diverges in ciphertext bytes from the default case. Plaintext is 35 bytes UTF-8 ('false' is one byte longer than 'true'); expected blob is 101 bytes (34-header + 35-plaintext + 32-CTX-tag).

Round-trip with encrypt-default: the blob bytes from case 1 decode back to PrefsView{ screen_capture_protection: true } under the same root_key + account_number_hash. Verifies the full encode→decode pipeline byte-for-byte.

Cross-vault attack scenario: a vault.prefs encoded under vault A's (root_key=0x42×32, account_hash=0x33×16) bytes are placed in vault B's directory and the decoder is invoked with vault B's (root_key=0xAB×32, account_hash=0xCD×16). The decoder MUST report a non-distinguishing AEAD failure — both the prefs_key mismatch (different root_key) and the AAD mismatch (different account_number_hash) contribute, but the surface is a single CannotDecrypt outcome per spec §6.4 + §9.5.5. Implementations MUST NOT distinguish which mismatch fired.

Tamper-detection scenario: a single byte of ciphertext at offset 40 of the encrypt-default blob has been flipped via XOR 0xFF (changed from 0x91 to 0x6e). The decoder is invoked with the ORIGINAL root_key + account_number_hash. The CTX commitment construction (SHA-256 over key||nonce||AAD-len||AAD||Poly1305-tag) MUST detect the modification — the recomputed Poly1305 tag changes, the recomputed CTX commitment changes, the constant-time comparison fails. Output is a non-distinguishing AEAD failure indistinguishable (at the caller-visible surface) from cross-vault.

Fully-populated v0.1 schema (MYND-183): every field set, exercising the unified heterogeneous item_order (note UUIDs + canonical folder paths interleaved) + favorites alongside deliberate_folders, auto_lock_seconds, and editor_layout. Same root_key + account_hash as encrypt-default; distinct prefs_nonce (0x99×24). Pins the canonical key order (auto_lock_seconds < deliberate_folders < editor_layout < favorites < item_order < screen_capture_protection) and the sequence-vs-set encoding discipline (item_order/favorites preserve order verbatim; deliberate_folders is sorted+deduped). The plaintext mirrors the spec §9.5.2 worked example.

Round-trip with encrypt-populated: the fully-populated blob decodes back to the same PrefsView under the same root_key + account_number_hash. Verifies the decode side reconstructs the heterogeneous item_order + favorites + all other fields in order (sequence arrays preserved verbatim; the omitted-when-default discipline is exercised by the other cases).

MYND-110 theme field: screen_capture_protection=true plus an explicit theme=dark. Pins the canonical key position of 'theme' (lexicographically LAST — t > s, so it follows screen_capture_protection) and its lowercase JSON-string encoding ('light'/'dark'). theme is Option<ThemeChoice> where absence is the canonical encoding of system (follow the OS), so this Some(Dark) case is the only shape that emits the key; a None/system vault stays byte-identical to encrypt-default (omit-when-None). Same root_key + account_hash as encrypt-default; distinct prefs_nonce (0xAA×24). Plaintext is 49 bytes UTF-8.

Round-trip with encrypt-themed-dark: the blob decodes back to PrefsView{ screen_capture_protection: true, theme: dark } under the same root_key + account_number_hash. Verifies the decoder parses the theme string after screen_capture_protection and maps 'dark' to ThemeChoice::Dark.

Encode case with the three MYND-191 daily-notes fields set (daily_date_format=YYYY-MM-DD, daily_folder=Daily/, daily_template=<uuid>) + screen_capture_protection=true. Pins the canonical key order daily_date_format < daily_folder < daily_template < screen_capture_protection and the omitted-when-default discipline (a vault without these fields encodes to the shorter encrypt-default blob). Inputs: root_key=0x42x32, account_hash=0x33x16, nonce=0xBBx24.
Round-trip with encrypt-daily: the blob decodes back to a PrefsView carrying the three daily-notes fields + screen_capture_protection=true under the same root_key + account_number_hash.

Encode case with the MYND-184 item_colors + MYND-185 folder_icons decoration maps set (+ screen_capture_protection=true). Pins the canonical key order folder_icons < item_colors < screen_capture_protection and the nested string→string object encoding: object members are emitted in lexicographic KEY order (folder_icons keys Archive/2025/ < Projects/Myne/; item_colors keys are heterogeneous note-UUID-or-folder-path, 0190a000-… < Projects/Myne/). Both maps are omitted-when-empty, so a vault without decorations encodes to the shorter encrypt-default blob. Inputs: root_key=0x42x32, account_hash=0x33x16, nonce=0xCCx24.

Round-trip with encrypt-decorations: the blob decodes back to a PrefsView carrying the folder_icons + item_colors maps + screen_capture_protection=true under the same root_key + account_number_hash. Verifies the decoder parses both nested string→string objects in canonical position (between favorites and item_order).

MYND-205 vault label. PrefsView carries item_order (two heterogeneous entries) + label; the label is supplied in NFD in the generator source ('Cafe' + U+0301 combining acute) and MUST encode as NFC ('Café', bytes 43 61 66 c3 a9) in the canonical plaintext. Pins the NFC normalization on encode AND the canonical key order item_order (i) < label (l) < screen_capture_protection (s). Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_label_and_tolerance_prefs_vectors -- --ignored` (in protocol/src/prefs.rs).

Round-trip with encrypt-labeled: the blob decodes back to a PrefsView carrying item_order + the NFC label 'Café' + screen_capture_protection=true under the same root_key + account_number_hash. Verifies decoders surface the MYND-205 label field from its canonical position between item_order and screen_capture_protection.

Forward-compat (spec §9.5.2): the sealed inner plaintext carries a genuinely unknown additive field zz_future_pref (in sorted position after theme); decoders must ignore it and recover the known fields rather than rejecting. expected_plaintext_canonical_utf8_hex is the canonical re-encode of the decoded view WITHOUT the unknown field — NOT the sealed bytes, which live verbatim in informational_sealed_plaintext_utf8_hex. Generated by `cargo test -p protocol --lib emit_label_and_tolerance_prefs_vectors -- --ignored` (in protocol/src/prefs.rs).
